act_title: The National Institutes of Design Act, 2014
title: Acts and proceedings not to be invalidated by vacancies, etc
text:
33. Acts and proceedings not to be invalidated by vacancies, etc.—No act of [any Institute] or

Governing Council or Senate or any other authority, set up under this Act or the Statutes, shall be invalid
merely by reason of—

(a) any vacancy in, or defect in the constitution thereof; or

(b) any defect in the election, nomination or appointment of a person acting as a member thereof;

or

(c) any irregularity in its procedure not affecting the merits of the case.
